latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Zotero Scholar (zotero-myscholar):

- Save academic papers, metadata, PDF links, and AI-generated summaries directly to your Zotero library.
- Supports de-duplication by paper URL and adds notes/tags.
- Downloads and attaches PDFs from arXiv if available.
- Requires configuration of ZOTERO_CREDENTIALS environment variable (format: userid:apiKey).
- Command-line usage via Python script with clear argument options.
